description: The plot illustrates the similarity across different layers for four distinct combinations, namely en&en, en&el, en&es, and en&bn. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 2 to 22 with a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.05 to 0.45 with a tick label interval of 0.05. The red line, representing en&en, starts at approximately 0.08 at layer 2, peaks at around 0.35 at layer 4, and then gradually decreases to about 0.25 at layer 18 before sharply increasing to 0.45 at layer 22. The blue line, representing en&es, begins at roughly 0.07 at layer 2, reaches a peak of approximately 0.32 at layer 4, and then declines to around 0.24 at layer 18 before rising to 0.42 at layer 22. The green line, representing en&el, starts at about 0.06 at layer 2, peaks at around 0.22 at layer 4, and then gradually increases to approximately 0.26 at layer 10 before decreasing to 0.24 at layer 18 and finally surging to 0.45 at layer 22. The pink line, representing en&bn, begins at roughly 0.05 at layer 2, reaches a peak of approximately 0.20 at layer 4, and then rises to around 0.26 at layer 10 before declining to 0.23 at layer 18 and eventually jumping to 0.44 at layer 22.
